title: Linear Inequalities
seo_title: Linear Inequalities – JSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Solve linear inequalities in one variable; show solutions on a number line; list integer solutions. (summary of the NERDC JSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 3 maths worksheets on inequalities: reading inequality signs, number lines, listing integers and solving linear inequalities. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Multiply or divide by a negative: flip the sign.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • < less than, > greater than, ≤ less than or equal to, ≥ greater than or equal to.
  • Solve an inequality like an equation: 3x + 2 < 14 → 3x < 12 → x < 4.
  • If you multiply or divide by a negative number, reverse the inequality sign.

Examples

Example

−2x ≥ 8

Divide by −2 and flip

Answer: x ≤ −4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Not flipping the sign for negatives−x > 3 means x < −3.
Open and closed circlesClosed for ≤ and ≥, open for < and >.
Including the end point wronglyx < 4 does not include 4.
